_provenance.source: FAA d-TPP cycle 2610 instrument approach plates for KPGD (the PDFs listed in kpgd-procedures.json)
_provenance.method: Glidepath angle / TCH and the missed approach climb altitude were read from each rendered plate (pdftoppm 150 dpi) and confirmed against the pdfjs-dist text layer (GS/GP and TCH labels, MISSED APPROACH box). Every value equals the figure transcribed in kpgd-procedures.json. HUMAN TRANSCRIPTION - verify against the PDFs before any real use.
_provenance.terms: TCH = threshold crossing height above the runway threshold of the plate's glidepath (GS = ILS glideslope, GP = RNAV glidepath, VDA = visual descent angle of a non-precision approach). It is NOT the VGSI TCH printed in the '(VGSI Angle x/TCH y)' note, which belongs to the visual glide slope indicator (NASR threshold_crossing_height_ft in the facility file). KPGD runway 22: the plate prints GP 3.00 TCH 40 and a separate 'VGSI Angle 3.00/TCH 31' (NASR threshold_crossing_height_ft 31); the plate value 40 is used here.
